rules.name: parent-lots-02-legacy-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT n.trade_id, n.value_date AS new_value_date, n.active_lots AS new_lots, (SELECT p.value_date FROM deal_active_lots_table_cfs p WHERE p.trade_id = n.trade_id AND p.value_date < n.value_date ORDER BY p.value_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS prev_value_date, (SELECT p.active_lots FROM deal_active_lots_table_cfs p WHERE p.trade_id = n.trade_id AND p.value_date < n.value_date ORDER BY p.value_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS prev_lots FROM deal_active_lots_table_cfs n WHERE n.value_date >= :from_date ORDER BY n.value_date, n.trade_id

SELECT d.parent_trade_id, d.trade_id, d.market_action, d.original_lots, d.lots_to_be_netted, d.deal_status, d.version_no, d.transaction_date, d.trade_source, d.version_created_by AS who, d.version_timestamp AS at FROM deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date ORDER BY d.version_timestamp DESC
